name: Frontend Accessibility Best Practices
summary: Accessibility (a11y) best practices for React components. Use when creating UI components, forms, interactive elements, or reviewing code for accessibility compliance.

name: Frontend React Best Practices
summary: React performance optimization guidelines. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React components to ensure optimal rendering and bundle patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, hooks, memoization, or bundle optimization.

name: Frontend Tailwind Best Practices
summary: Tailwind CSS patterns and conventions for frontend apps. Use when writing component styles, layouts, or working with CSS classes.

name: Frontend Testing Best Practices
summary: Testing best practices for the frontend. Emphasizes E2E tests over unit tests, minimal mocking, and testing behavior over implementation details. Use when writing tests or reviewing test code.

name: Owasp Security Check
summary: Security audit guidelines for web applications and REST APIs based on OWASP Top 10 and web security best practices. Use when checking code for vulnerabilities, reviewing auth/authz, auditing APIs, or before production deployment.
